1. ANALYTICS CORRECTNESS (src/analytics/track.ts + its init + index.html): does track() dispatch all 3 events to BOTH GA4 (gtag) and Meta Pixel (fbq)? 2. NO-OP SAFETY: with empty/placeholder GA4 + Pixel IDs, does anything load, throw, or log console errors? Are all gtag/fbq calls guarded so a missing vendor global can't throw? Is the placeholder/isConfigured detection correct (no false-positive dispatch on placeholder ids like G-XXXXXXXXXX)?
3. CONDITIONAL LOADING: are vendor scripts loaded ONLY when IDs are present AND consent granted? Any double-load (index.html + runtime injection both firing) or load-before-consent?
4. CONSENT: is the consent hook respected before dispatch AND before loading vendor scripts?
5. CTA / PROMO / UTM (src/config/env.ts buildBuyUrl + ResultsScene.onBuy): does the final buy URL carry BOTH the promo code AND utm_source/medium/campaign? Is it well-formed (proper encoding, single '?', no duplicate keys)?
6. ENV: does .env.example document every VITE_* var with placeholder defaults, and do the names agree with env.ts exactly?
7. PERF / A11Y: is the audio blob-URL revocation correct (revoked only AFTER load so playback isn't broken)? Any real pooling leak or per-frame allocation in steady state?
8. 326	### 7.1 Adapter design
327	
328	A **thin `track(event, params)` adapter** is the single choke point for all analytics. Game code never calls `gtag`/`fbq` directly — it calls `track()`, which fans out to **GA4 (gtag)** and **Meta Pixel (fbq)**.
329	
330	```ts
331	type AnalyticsEvent = 'start_game' | 'finish_game' | 'click_buy';
332	
333	function track(event: AnalyticsEvent, params: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void {
334	  // GA4
335	  window.gtag?.('event', event, params);
336	  // Meta Pixel — custom events via trackCustom
337	  window.fbq?.('trackCustom', event, params);
338	  // Dev/QA: console mirror when a debug flag is on
339	  if (DEBUG_ANALYTICS) console.debug('[track]', event, params);
340	}
341	```
342	
343	Rationale:
344	- **One contract, two sinks.** Adding/removing a sink (or a consent gate) is a one-file change.
345	- **Safe if a pixel is absent.** Optional chaining means a missing/blocked `gtag`/`fbq` never throws (ad-blockers are common on the audience).
346	- **Testable.** Event emission can be asserted in isolation.
347	
348	### 7.2 Event / parameter contract
349	
350	#### `start_game` — a round begins
351	
352	| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
353	|---|---|---|---|---|
354	| *(none required)* | — | — | — | Fired once when the Play scene starts the run |
355	
356	#### `finish_game` — fires on BOTH Victory and Game Over
357	
358	| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
359	|---|---|---|---|---|
360	| `result` | `'win' \| 'lose'` | ✅ | `'win'` | `win` = reached finish; `lose` = 0 HP |
361	| `score` | integer | ✅ | `1450` | Final score at round end |
362	| `duration_s` | integer (seconds) | ✅ | `72` | **Active play time, excluding paused time.** Measured by accumulating elapsed time each frame while the run is playing; the accumulator is **frozen while paused** (§6.3) so paused time never inflates it. Reported at round end |
363	
364	#### `click_buy` — CTA tapped on results screen
365	
366	| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
367	|---|---|---|---|---|
368	| `destination` | string | ✅ | `'tabletki.ua'` | Fixed for MVP |
369	| `promo_code` | string | ✅ | `'DOG10'` | The code shown on the CTA (see §11) |
370	
371	> All three event **names** are fixed by the brief (§3B: `start_game`, `finish_game`, `click_buy`) — do not rename.
372	
373	### 7.3 GA4 (gtag) + Meta Pixel (fbq) wiring
374	
375	- Both snippets load in `index.html` `<head>` (standard install), parameterized by **GA4 Measurement ID** and **Meta Pixel ID** (see §11 — needed before launch).
376	- IDs injected via Vite env vars (`VITE_GA4_ID`, `VITE_FB_PIXEL_ID`) so staging/prod differ without code edits.
377	- GA4 receives events via `gtag('event', …)`; Meta Pixel via `fbq('trackCustom', …)`. (Meta standard events like `Purchase` are **not** used — the brief's three custom names take priority; a `Purchase` mapping can be added later if the client wants Ads Manager optimization on it.)
378	- **GA4 custom dimensions/metrics:** the custom params (`result`, `score`, `duration_s`, `destination`, `promo_code`) must be **registered as custom dimensions/metrics in the GA4 property** (GA4 Admin → Custom definitions) or they will be collected but **won't surface in GA4 reports**. Register `result`/`destination`/`promo_code` as dimensions and `score`/`duration_s` as metrics as part of launch setup.
379	
380	### 7.4 Consent / GDPR note
381	
382	- The audience is EU-adjacent (Ukraine); ad pixels imply personal-data processing.
383	- **Recommendation:** a lightweight consent gate. `track()` is the natural enforcement point — buffer or drop events until consent is granted, and only initialize `fbq`/`gtag` post-consent (Consent Mode v2 for GA4).
384	- Exact consent UX / whether a CMP is required depends on the client's legal stance — **flag in §11.** MVP ships the adapter consent-ready even if the banner is deferred.

327	
328	A **thin `track(event, params)` adapter** is the single choke point for all analytics. Game code never calls `gtag`/`fbq` directly — it calls `track()`, which fans out to **GA4 (gtag)** and **Meta Pixel (fbq)**.
329	
330	```ts
331	type AnalyticsEvent = 'start_game' | 'finish_game' | 'click_buy';
332	
333	function track(event: AnalyticsEvent, params: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void {
334	  // GA4
335	  window.gtag?.('event', event, params);
336	  // Meta Pixel — custom events via trackCustom
337	  window.fbq?.('trackCustom', event, params);
338	  // Dev/QA: console mirror when a debug flag is on
339	  if (DEBUG_ANALYTICS) console.debug('[track]', event, params);
340	}
341	```
342	
343	Rationale:
344	- **One contract, two sinks.** Adding/removing a sink (or a consent gate) is a one-file change.
345	- **Safe if a pixel is absent.** Optional chaining means a missing/blocked `gtag`/`fbq` never throws (ad-blockers are common on the audience).
346	- **Testable.** Event emission can be asserted in isolation.
347	
348	### 7.2 Event / parameter contract
349	
350	#### `start_game` — a round begins
351	
352	| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
353	|---|---|---|---|---|
354	| *(none required)* | — | — | — | Fired once when the Play scene starts the run |
355	
356	#### `finish_game` — fires on BOTH Victory and Game Over
357	
358	| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
359	|---|---|---|---|---|
360	| `result` | `'win' \| 'lose'` | ✅ | `'win'` | `win` = reached finish; `lose` = 0 HP |
361	| `score` | integer | ✅ | `1450` | Final score at round end |
362	| `duration_s` | integer (seconds) | ✅ | `72` | **Active play time, excluding paused time.** Measured by accumulating elapsed time each frame while the run is playing; the accumulator is **frozen while paused** (§6.3) so paused time never inflates it. Reported at round end |
363	
364	#### `click_buy` — CTA tapped on results screen
365	
366	| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
367	|---|---|---|---|---|
368	| `destination` | string | ✅ | `'tabletki.ua'` | Fixed for MVP |
369	| `promo_code` | string | ✅ | `'DOG10'` | The code shown on the CTA (see §11) |
370	
371	> All three event **names** are fixed by the brief (§3B: `start_game`, `finish_game`, `click_buy`) — do not rename.

373	### 7.3 GA4 (gtag) + Meta Pixel (fbq) wiring
374	
375	- Both snippets load in `index.html` `<head>` (standard install), parameterized by **GA4 Measurement ID** and **Meta Pixel ID** (see §11 — needed before launch).
376	- IDs injected via Vite env vars (`VITE_GA4_ID`, `VITE_FB_PIXEL_ID`) so staging/prod differ without code edits.
377	- GA4 receives events via `gtag('event', …)`; Meta Pixel via `fbq('trackCustom', …)`. (Meta standard events like `Purchase` are **not** used — the brief's three custom names take priority; a `Purchase` mapping can be added later if the client wants Ads Manager optimization on it.)
378	- **GA4 custom dimensions/metrics:** the custom params (`result`, `score`, `duration_s`, `destination`, `promo_code`) must be **registered as custom dimensions/metrics in the GA4 property** (GA4 Admin → Custom definitions) or they will be collected but **won't surface in GA4 reports**. Register `result`/`destination`/`promo_code` as dimensions and `score`/`duration_s` as metrics as part of launch setup.

383	- **Recommendation:** a lightweight consent gate. `track()` is the natural enforcement point — buffer or drop events until consent is granted, and only initialize `fbq`/`gtag` post-consent (Consent Mode v2 for GA4).
384	- Exact consent UX / whether a CMP is required depends on the client's legal stance — **flag in §11.** MVP ships the adapter consent-ready even if the banner is deferred.

## Phase 5 Review — FINDINGS: EMPTY (0 real defects)

Reviewed Phase 5 changes against spec §7 / §8.5 / §10 in the deploy context (local gh-pages deploy, no CI, `base: '/HappyDog/'`). **No real MVP defects found.** `npm run typecheck` → exit 0; `npm run build` → exit 0; `dist/index.html` active script is `/HappyDog/assets/index-D6OURhlT.js` (correctly base-prefixed). ### 1. ANALYTICS CORRECTNESS — CLEAN ✅
`src/analytics/track.ts:86-104` dispatches EVERY event to BOTH sinks (`gtag('event', …)` line 92 + `fbq('trackCustom', …)` line 97), `typeof`-guarded. Names/shapes match §7.2 exactly:

- `click_buy {destination, promo_code}` — `ResultsScene.ts:151`; `destination`=`buyDestination()`='tabletki.ua' (matches spec example).

### 2. NO-OP SAFETY — CLEAN ✅
With empty/placeholder IDs: `isConfigured()` (`track.ts:53-60`) rejects `''`, `G-XXXXXXXXXX` (`/^g-x+$/`), all-`0`/all-`x` — verified in node, **no false-positives**; real IDs (`G-1A2B3C4D5E`, 15-digit numeric) → true. `initAnalytics()` (`:113-124`) loads nothing when unconfigured, so `window.gtag`/`fbq` stay undefined and `track()`'s `typeof` guards make it a silent no-op. No console errors emitted (the only `console.error` is PreloadScene's `FILE_LOAD_ERROR`, which won't fire — SVG finals exist, audio is blob URLs).

### 3. CONDITIONAL LOADING — CLEAN ✅
`index.html:37-66` analytics are HTML **comments** (verified inert in `dist/index.html` — the gtag ref stays inside `<!-- -->`, never active), so there's no second load path. Runtime injection (`loadGa4`/`loadPixel`) runs only from `initAnalytics()`, env-gated AND consent-gated, idempotent via `ga4Loaded`/`pixelLoaded`. No double-load, no load-before-consent.

### 4. CONSENT — CLEAN ✅
`track()` checks `hasConsent()` before dispatch (`:87`); `initAnalytics()` checks it before loading vendors (`:114`); `setAnalyticsConsent(true)` re-inits for a deferred CMP grant (`:69-74`). Hook is genuinely respected on both sides (§7.4). Banner deferred is a §11 open question, not a defect.

### 5. CTA / PROMO / UTM — CLEAN ✅
`env.ts:47-59` `buildBuyUrl()` (verified in node) → `https://tabletki.ua/?promo=DOG10&utm_source=happydogrunner&utm_medium=game&utm_campaign=tick_protection`: single `?`, proper encoding, **BOTH promo + all 3 UTMs**, no dup keys (URL API + `searchParams.set`). `ResultsScene.onBuy` (`:149-153`) fires `click_buy` synchronously then `window.open(url,'_blank','noopener')` inside the gesture (popup-safe).

### 6. ENV — CLEAN ✅
